description: Defines data structures and constants for RACH (Random Access Channel) configuration in 5G NR, including generic and cell-specific parameters, with focus on PRACH preamble management and prioritization.

classes.name: rach_config_generic
classes.description: Configuration parameters for generic RACH settings, including PRACH index, response window, and power settings.

classes.name: ra_prioritization
classes.description: Parameters for prioritizing random access procedures, including power ramping step and backoff scaling.

classes.name: ra_prioritization_slice_info
classes.description: Contains slice-specific RA prioritization info, including a list of NSAG IDs and associated priority.

classes.name: rach_config_common
classes.description: Cell-specific RACH configuration parameters, including generic config, preamble counts, timers, and sequence indices.
